prompt: Out of all of Steven Spielberg's Oscar winning movies up until 2020, which one has made the most money?
answer: **Jurassic Park (1993)** has made the most money among Steven Spielberg’s Oscar-winning films released through 2020. It won **three Academy Awards** and earned approximately **$1.1 billion worldwide**.
